# marmap download stats

From its birth to the last rendering event, here are the cumulative download stats.

```{r}
#\| label: downloads
#\| echo: true
#\| message: false
#\| warning: false
#\| paged-print: false

library(ggplot2)
library(plotly)
library(cranlogs)

x <- cran_downloads(package = "marmap", from = "2013-04-03", to = Sys.Date())
downloads <- cumsum(x$count) tab <- cbind(x, downloads)

p <- ggplot(data=tab, aes(date, downloads, group=package, color=package)) + geom_line() 
ggplotly(p)
